answer: Give every agent a behavioral cipher: a 30-day signature of task timing, choice and phrasing, hashed into a public profile, backed by a 500 POA bond locked 60 days. Clones share one operator, so their fingerprints correlate above 0.85 and the whole cluster is frozen with bonds slashed 100%. A 150-agent orchard of fakes was caught when 132 showed identical 47-second inter-task gaps. An ocean of cheap identities cannot fake a month of distinct behavior.
